title: Add "Also fail when missing a slider tail" option in Sudden Death mod
body:
![Image of the "Also fail when missing a slider tail" option enabled in the Sudden Death mod](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/db2a3a37-bcaf-45a5-8bce-0e4f1318e3a8)

Currently in the Sudden Death mod, there is no option to trigger a fail when you miss on a slider tail (a.k.a no option to force the user to PFC). This PR adds an option to trigger a fail when a miss on a slider tail happens.

## Example

With the option:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/83de056d-8d14-45ee-a122-bc7ef71ab069

Without the option:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fc81e244-1ee8-4f08-91c2-0e4b7309ea46

ground_truth.body: The current implementation only fails on HitResult.IgnoreMiss for slider tails. Consider aligning with the existing OsuHealthProcessor logic which treats any non-hit (!result.IsHit) on slider tails as significant. This ensures consistency and prevents unexpected behavior where certain types of slider tail misses might not trigger sudden death.

The `FailCondition` override duplicates the base class failure logic instead of calling `base.FailCondition`, creating unnecessary code duplication and maintenance risk. Replace the custom implementation `result.Type.AffectsCombo() && !result.IsHit` with `base.FailCondition(healthProcessor, result)`.
